title: Voice from Auritus for the announcer
description: The announcer sample (voice-layer example) was made with macOS say, whose license is unclear; it is hidden as undocumented. Generate a replacement voice with ~/Projects/Auritus under a clear license.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Another session is integrating Auritus into Apricity for voice generation (in its own worktree); this task belongs to that work.
